skill.summary: Explain, summarize, analyze, or adapt the "Republic with No Masters" / Democratic Formalism governance framework when asked to produce content, guidance, critiques, FAQs, or implementation ideas based on the manifesto in principles.md.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the "republic-no-masters" skill:

- Provides explanations, summaries, analyses, or adaptations of the "Republic with No Masters" / Democratic Formalism framework based strictly on principles.md.
- Ensures all outputs are grounded in the manifesto, following its terms and intent.
- Clearly distinguishes between factual explanations and speculative proposals.
- Includes specific output formats for summaries, overviews, FAQs, system designs, and public writing.
- Implements strong guardrails: avoids inventing new claims, using unapproved terminology, or overreaching real-world applicability.
